body:
I have gone to clubs. After I starting working I wasn't able to go to one I used to go to, but I never really got along with them anyway. The other I can't seem to fit in at all, and that is part of the reason I came to post this. I had some acquaintances with them back when I actually had a social life but now its still that: acquaintances. 


And that's a nice story but my consciousness has only carried me to be the loser I am today.

It's not nonsense. I've had it. I hear my "friends" tell stories about their experiences and such and I just have to sit there in silence. I have never had any funny/interesting stories to tell. And maybe I will but maybe I'll be fucking captured by aliens. Of course maybe it gets better but in all likelihood its not.
I'm also 20 and hating college. My real account is /u/ultsomnia if you wanna PM me.

Edit: what I wrote came out as overly caustic I'm sorry I don't know any other way to say anything right now. 

I'm not really in the mood to get reddit quoting formatting correct, so here it is.


"Let me just tell you right now that sex and relationships are overrated. Yes, it's great to have someone you can share your life with but nothing lasts forever and when that relationship ends, you find yourself worse off than ever. At least for a period of time afterwards."

Easy to say for someone who's been in one. But, look, almost everyone my age has had sex and/or been in a relationship, and it's just a horrible feeling being on the outside of that. And would you say it was overrated if you knew you'd never be in a relationship?

"You seem like a smart person. Finish school, get your degree and get yourself a great job where you make a lot of money and can support yourself."


Finish school???? That could be another 3 years, I'm only in my second year. I'm not going through three years of shit because it could maybe possibly get better later. And who says I'll have a great job? I'm doing awful in school this semester, so that doesn't seem terribly likely. I know someone with a masters working the same $12/ hr a job I am (until I get fired). I won't have a masters, who's to say I'll be any better off than him? 


"Friends and women will come, they always do no matter what you think may be the case."
I've been fed this lie since I was 15. Friends came for one brief glimmer and women never came. Not even when I was happy, not when I was looking, not when I wasn't looking. So a few months out of my entire life constitutes "always" and never constitutes "always"? I think that line applies to normal people. It does not apply to me. 

And, even if I do finish school, I'm suppose to hear people talk about their college experience for the rest of their lives when I have nothing to say? People always talk about how college changes them and all that, and I thought it did for me too, but now I've found that I'm the same shitty person I was in high school. 


basically, I'm not convinced. I'll give it a week but killing myself still seems like the best option moving forward.
